ad_info.reference_style: Clean, modern three-stage progress ad: three circular photo frames of increasing size threaded on one horizontal timeline, showing the same woman gaining energy and confidence over a 3-month plan, with the product anchoring the bottom
ad_info.angle_used: Transformación / resultado: el plan natural de 3 meses contado como proceso

global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226, bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE and white #FFFFFF. For this variation the background is pale blush pink #FBE3EE with dark plum #2B1226 texts and fuchsia accents.
global_identity.visual_style: Photorealistic, bold and feminine supplement ad for Colombian women: a real-looking woman in a real home, the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo, fuchsia and plum brand accents.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Hopeful, warm and believable; progress that feels real and gradual.
global_identity.graphic_language: Circular photo frames with thin white outlines and soft shadows, a thin timeline track with small chevrons, rounded pills, clean high-contrast typography readable on a phone, clean flat background.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black look), uppercase; labels and captions in a rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins SemiBold look).

creative_objective: Sell the 3-month plan as a believable process: the same woman gains energy, then routine, then confidence in her jeans, so the viewer understands the treatment of 3 bottles and keeps realistic expectations, without any body comparison.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Bold headline at the top. 2) The three circles growing left to right, the largest ringed in fuchsia. 3) The bottle centered in the bottom band. 4) The month pills and the captions. 5) The small seal and the small legal note.
art_direction.composition_style: Horizontal left-to-right progression with deliberate size growth. Headline centered in the top band. Three circles with centers on the same line at about 46% of the height: circle 1 about 20% of the width (centered at about 17%), circle 2 about 25% (centered at about 43%), circle 3 about 32% (centered at about 75%). Thin timeline track behind them with a small chevron in each gap. A pill straddles the top edge of each circle. Captions on one shared baseline. Bottle centered in the bottom band; small seal pill bottom left; small legal note bottom right.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline from about 6% to 19% of the height; circles between about 30% and 62% (circle 1 about 7-27% of the width and 36-56% of the height, circle 2 about 30.5-55.5% and 33.5-58.5%, circle 3 about 59-91% and 30-62%); captions from about 65% to 71%; bottle band from about 74% to 95%, bottle about 20-22% of the canvas height. Seal pill about 6-32% of the width and 84-90% of the height. Legal note about 70-94% of the width and 85-89% of the height. Safe margins of about 6% on every side.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Inside the circles: identical camera angle, crop and window light in all three stages; stage 1 slightly cooler and muted, stage 2 neutral, stage 3 warmest and most vibrant. Each circle has a thin white outline and a soft drop shadow; circle 3 adds a fuchsia ring and a faint fuchsia glow. The bottle gets a soft studio key light from the upper left, a subtle rim light and a soft contact shadow.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas with a pale blush pink background. Headline centered at the top in dark plum with the time expression in fuchsia. Across the middle, three circular photos of the same woman in front of the same bedroom mirror, growing in size from left to right along a thin timeline track with chevrons. A rounded pill on the top edge of each circle (Mes 1, Mes 2, Mes 3), the largest circle ringed in fuchsia. A short caption under each circle. The real bottle centered in the bottom band with a soft shadow; a small registration pill at the bottom left and a small legal note at the bottom right.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 clean progress-timeline supplement ad. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. Flat pale blush pink #FBE3EE background with a very subtle lighter top. Top center (6-19% of the height) a two-line extra-bold uppercase headline in dark plum #2B1226 with '3 MESES' in fuchsia #E6177F. Across the middle, three circular photos growing from left to right along a thin horizontal timeline track at about 46% of the height (mauve on the left turning fuchsia on the right, a small chevron pointing right in each gap): circle 1 about 20% of the width at 7-27% of the width, circle 2 about 25% at 30.5-55.5%, circle 3 about 32% at 59-91%, each with a thin white outline and a soft drop shadow; circle 3 has a fuchsia ring and a faint fuchsia glow. All three circles show the SAME Colombian woman about 28 years old, light brown skin, curly brown hair in a loose bun, in front of the same full-length bedroom mirror with the same waist-up three-quarter framing and the same window light: circle 1, loose gray hoodie, tired and unsure, muted cool tones; circle 2, fitted black workout top and a gym bag on her shoulder, energized, neutral tones; circle 3, medium-blue fitted high-waisted jeans and a fuchsia blouse, standing tall with a big confident smile, warm vibrant tones. Her body stays realistic and the same in all three: the change is mood, energy and confidence, not body size. A rounded pill straddles the top edge of each circle (pills 1 and 2 muted mauve, pill 3 fuchsia, white text). One short caption centered under each circle on a shared baseline at about 65-71% of the height, dark plum, the third in fuchsia. Bottom left (6-32% of the width, 84-90% of the height) a small rounded dark plum pill with a tiny white check-shield icon and white text. Bottom right (70-94% of the width, 85-89% of the height) a small plain dark plum legal note. Clean, airy, everything readable on a phone. No other elements.
